content.what_it_is: MATLAB bathymetry generator for the FUNWAVE-TVD rip_tracking case; variant of the rip_2d makebath.m whose header adds 'and sediment' to the purpose statement (L3-L4). Differences from the rip_2d version: ncell=2 periodic cells (L10), cross-shore scale xcell=60 (L18), and depth clipped at 8 m (h(h>8)=8, L43) instead of 13. Identical machinery otherwise: ycell=100 (L14); dx=1, dy=2, slope s=1/30, channel center xc=100, amplitude a=1.5, sig2=xc*xc/4, bet=2 (L22); x from -11 to 5*xcell=300, y cell-centered dy/2..ncell*ycell-dy/2 (L23); planar beach h=s*xx (L27); rip channel centers yc=(0:ncell)*ycell (L31); commented symmetry-breaking shift (L33-L35); subtraction of ncell+1 anisotropic Gaussians (L37-L41); quick contour with levels 0..10 (L45-L47); ASCII save to depth_a15.txt (L49); 6x6 inch figure with pcolor of -h and white contours at -10..0 (L51-L64).
entities: ncell number of periodic cells L10
xx, yy meshgrid L24 (reassigned as 1D vectors L56-L57)

equations.ref: anisotropic Gaussian depression per cell center

verbatim_spans.text: % breaking in periodic bathymetry and sediment

unresolved: with xcell=60 the domain x extends only to 300 while the Gaussian center is at xc=100 with sigma^2=2500 (L22-L23), so the channel structure occupies proportionally more of the shorter cross-shore domain than in rip_2d; intended relation between xcell and xc is not documented
the commented symmetry-breaking line yc(ncell/2) (L35) would index yc(1) for ncell=2, i.e. the first center, not a middle one
same output filename depth_a15.txt as the rip_2d version (L49) though grid sizes differ; xx,yy change meaning mid-script (L24 vs L56-L57)
